gloss: to be consistent; to be coherent throughout

definitions.gloss: to be consistent; to be coherent throughout; to remain unchanged
definitions.explanation: For a position, attitude, policy, or quality to remain the same from beginning to end without contradiction. Often used approvingly to describe someone who holds firm to their principles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一貫|いっかん}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{一貫|いっかん}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: His argument has been consistent from the start.

examples.japanese: {一貫|いっかん}した⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めて→進める：01949_susumeru⟧きた。
examples.english: We have advanced the business under a consistent policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{一貫|いっかん}して⟦{自社|じしゃ}→自社：14070_jisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We handle the entire process in-house, from design through manufacturing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) and ⟦{貫|かん}→貫：28717_kan⟧ (pierce, penetrate). Literally 'to pierce through as one,' conveying the image of a single thread running through something from start to finish. Often used as the adverb {一貫|いっかん}して (consistently, throughout).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一貫|いっかん}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: one's attitude is consistent
- ⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一貫|いっかん}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: one's argument is consistent
- {一貫|いっかん}した⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧: a consistent policy
- {一貫|いっかん}して: consistently, throughout
- ⟦{一貫|いっかん}→一貫：17700_ikkan_b⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧: integrated production

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {首尾|しゅび}⟦{一貫|いっかん}→一貫：17700_ikkan_b⟧: consistency from beginning to end — four-character compound emphasizing logical coherence
- ⟦{継続|けいぞく}する→継続する：26971_keizokusuru⟧: to continue — focuses on duration rather than unchanging quality
- ⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧: to be thorough — emphasizes completeness rather than consistency over time
